answer: Bank withdrawals may take 1 to 3 business days after approval [Cash withdrawal processing §article_02_c1].

Your reset link is not working after an hour because reset links expire after 30 minutes [Password reset and account recovery §article_01_c1]. This is expected for security reasons [Password reset and account recovery §article_01_c1].
Support cannot tell you what your password currently is [Password reset and account recovery §article_01_c1].
A utility bill from 8 months ago will not work for proof of address because utility bills older than 6 months are not accepted [Document verification requirements §article_03_c1].
You cannot withdraw profit made on a demo account [Demo account behaviour §article_04_c1]. To withdraw funds, you should switch to a real account [Demo account behaviour §article_04_c1].
